name: Shoes & sneakers
intro: Compare the silhouette, stated sizing system and available measurements before choosing a pair. Product photos help with discovery, but the exact seller listing should decide your size and options.
checks: Check EU / US / UK size labels and any insole length.
Review both shoes, labels and visible construction in warehouse photos.
Consider the shoe box when reviewing final parcel packing.

name: Sweatshirts & hoodies
intro: A relaxed fit in a photograph does not define the actual garment measurements. Compare a favourite sweatshirt with the listing’s chest, body length and sleeve measurements.
checks: Check zip-up, pullover and hood options.
Compare fabric descriptions and measurement charts.
Review labels and the selected colour after warehouse arrival.

name: T-shirts
intro: Start with the cut you want: regular, relaxed or oversized. Compare the actual measurements and the print placement on the seller listing rather than treating size letters as universal.
checks: Compare chest width and body length.
Check front, back and neckline details.
Confirm the selected colour and design before ordering.

name: Jackets & outerwear
intro: Think about how you will layer the jacket and compare shoulder, chest and sleeve dimensions. A photo alone cannot verify insulation, waterproofing or other performance claims.
checks: Read the material and lining descriptions.
Check fasteners, pockets and included accessories.
Review bulky packaging when choosing a shipping route.

name: Pants & shorts
intro: Compare waist, rise, hip, inseam and overall length when the seller provides them. Distinguish a garment measurement from a recommended body measurement.
checks: Check elastic versus fixed waist construction.
Confirm leg cut and intended length.
Inspect the selected size and colour in QC photos.

name: Headwear
intro: Caps, beanies and other headwear need different fit checks. Look for stated circumference, adjustable closures and construction details before adding an item to a haul.
checks: Confirm whether the size is adjustable.
Check brim shape and embroidery placement.
Consider packaging that protects the shape.

name: Accessories
intro: Small items can have important differences in dimensions, closures and included pieces. Use a clear seller description and measurements to compare similar-looking finds.
checks: Check dimensions and included accessories.
Verify the exact option and finish.
Check shipping restrictions for the item type.

name: Jerseys
intro: Check the jersey’s cut, measurement chart and selected design. Where a listing offers names, numbers or other customization, confirm those options before payment.
checks: Compare chest and length measurements.
Review any customization text carefully.
Check logos, numbers and visible stitching in available photos.

name: Short sets
intro: A matching set can include different pieces depending on the seller’s option. Confirm exactly what is included and compare measurements for both the top and shorts.
checks: Confirm set contents and selected colour.
Check top and bottom sizing separately.
Inspect each included piece on warehouse arrival.

name: Electronics
intro: Check the model, technical specifications, plug, voltage and included accessories. A catalog image or visual inspection does not establish electrical safety, device compatibility or functional performance.
checks: Verify regional compatibility and specifications.
Ask the platform about battery and route restrictions before purchase.
Read the seller’s support and return conditions.

name: Other finds
intro: For items outside the main categories, start with the intended use, dimensions and material description. Check any route restrictions before purchasing an unusual or bulky product.
checks: Verify what the listing actually includes.
Review dimensions and packaging requirements.
Confirm the route accepts the item before paying.
